project.name: treetracker-android
project.description: Grower-facing Android app for capturing trees as geotagged photos, managing grower accounts and wallets, and syncing captures to the Treetracker backend.

nodes.name: Tree Capture
nodes.summary: Core grower-facing flow to capture a tree as a geotagged photo. Manages camera, GPS convergence, image review with an optional note, and persistence of the tree record for later sync.

businessRules: GPS accuracy must converge below a configured threshold before capture
Every tree binds to an active capture session, user and wallet
A captured image needs review and approval before the tree persists
crossDomainInteractions: Uses the active grower from Grower Onboarding
Uses the selected wallet and organization from Organization & Wallet
Feeds captured trees into Data Sync & Upload

nodes.name: Grower Onboarding & Identity
nodes.summary: Handles grower (planter) sign-up, selection of the active grower, and profile management. Collects name and email/phone credentials and registers the grower with the backend.

businessRules: A grower needs a first and last name plus a valid email or phone credential
A user record tracks upload state for backend registration
crossDomainInteractions: Provides the active grower to Tree Capture
Registration payloads flow into Data Sync & Upload

nodes.name: Organization & Wallet Selection
nodes.summary: Manages the organization a grower belongs to and the destination wallet that receives captured trees. Supports adding new organizations and wallets during onboarding and capture setup.

businessRules: Captured trees route to a chosen destination wallet
An organization identifier configures the capture flow
A new wallet or org can be added on demand
crossDomainInteractions: Supplies capture setup (wallet/org) to Tree Capture
Org and wallet config sync via Data Sync & Upload

nodes.name: Data Sync & Upload
nodes.summary: Background orchestration that uploads growers, sessions, trees, location tracks, device config, and messages to the Treetracker API and image/data bundles to object storage. Runs as a WorkManager worker with progress notifications.

businessRules: Sync runs only when internet is available
Sync steps run in a fixed order and propagate failures
Uploaded records are marked to avoid re-upload
Images upload to object storage and are referenced by URL
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes captured trees from Tree Capture
Uploads grower registrations from Grower Onboarding
Uploads message bundles from Grower Messaging

nodes.name: Grower Messaging
nodes.summary: Two-way messaging between growers and the platform: direct chat, announcements, and surveys. Syncs paginated messages from the API, persists them locally, and uploads unsent messages and survey responses.

businessRules: Messages sync per wallet with API pagination
A survey collects answers before submitting a response
Unsent messages upload in windowed bundles
crossDomainInteractions: Messaging targets a grower/wallet from Grower Onboarding
Message bundles upload through Data Sync & Upload / object storage

nodes.name: Dashboard, Map & App Settings
nodes.summary: Grower-facing overview surfaces: a dashboard of sync stats and pending uploads, a map of captured trees, plus app settings and language selection. Provides navigation entry points into the main flows.

businessRules: The dashboard shows the count of trees still pending upload
The map renders only captured tree markers with detail cards
Settings expose feature toggles and logout
crossDomainInteractions: Displays sync progress and pending counts from Data Sync & Upload
Renders captured trees from Tree Capture

edges.description: Provides the active grower (planter) that a capture binds to
Supplies the destination wallet and org capture setup for captures
Captured trees and location tracks feed the upload pipeline
Grower registration payloads are uploaded during sync
Organization and device config records sync to the backend
Message and survey bundles upload through object storage
Sync progress and pending counts drive the dashboard
Captured trees render as markers on the tree map
Messaging targets a selected grower and wallet
